evidence.abstract:
The necessary appearance of Clifford algebras in the quantum descrip-
                                                   tion of fermions has prompted us to re-examine the fundamental role
                                                   played by the quaternion Clifford algebra, C0,2 . This algebra is essen-
                                                   tially the geometric algebra describing the rotational properties of space.
                                                   Hidden within this algebra are symplectic structures with Heisenberg alge-
                                                   bras at their core. This algebra also enables us to define a Poisson algebra
                                                   of all homogeneous quadratic polynomials on a two-dimensional sub-space,
                                                   Fa of the Euclidean three-space. This enables us to construct a Poisson
                                                   Clifford algebra, HF , of a finite dimensional phase space which will carry
                                                   the dynamics. The quantum dynamics appears as a realisation of HF in
                                                   terms of a Clifford algebra consisting of Hermitian operators.
